name: MO1-the-restrike-cut-by-its-own-release
old: this._release(when);   // a note struck again on its own release is struck after it, not cut by it
note: The release due on the re-strike's own tick is then flushed after the window - after the new note-on at the same time - and the device ends the note it has just struck: every repeated note in the archive cut to nothing.

name: MO1-the-stream-note-offs-sent-too
note: Every HMI note is released twice, and the stream's release of a note at its own length lands where a re-strike of it has already sounded - the doubling this player exists to avoid.

name: MO1-cc7-unscaled
old:
const v = scaledVolume(this._raw7[ch], this._scale(at));
    this._send([0xb0 | ch, 7, v], at);
new:
const v = this._raw7[ch];
    this._send([0xb0 | ch, 7, v], at);
note: The music slider, the video mute, the song's own level and every fade stop reaching the device: the song plays at its own CC7 whatever the player asked.

name: MO1-the-reset-after-the-origin
note: The reset lands after the song's tick-0 program changes and volumes and undoes them: every song plays its first pass on piano at full volume.

name: MO1-resync-does-nothing
note: The slider is heard at the next song, not this one - the bug the 2026-08-27 fix closed for the synth, back on the device.

name: MO1-the-volume-dropped-from-the-scale
note: Neither the slider nor the video mute reaches the device: a cutscene plays over the music at full volume.

name: MO1-the-song-level-dropped
note: The boss fight's score (WBX9) plays at the dungeon's level on a device, under the tracks it was made to stand over.

name: MO1-the-fade-at-its-end-at-once
note: A switch cuts instead of fading (DISC20-B): the level jumps to the fade's end at its first pump.

name: MO1-the-queued-note-released-before-it-sounds
old: this._send([0x80 | n.channel, n.note, 0], Math.max(now, n.on + MIDI_GAP_S));
note: A note-on queued in the window is released at the stop's instant, BEFORE it sounds - so it sounds after, and hangs on a device with no clear() (Chrome).

name: MO1-the-quiet-sent-once-before-the-queue
old: if (quiet > now + MIDI_GAP_S) this._send(m, quiet);   // and again after anything the window had queued
note: A pedal-down or a note the window had queued after the stop's instant outlives the all-notes-off and holds into the next song.

name: MO1-the-next-origin-ignoring-the-quiet
old: const t = Math.max(this.ctx.currentTime + lead, this._quietAt + 2 * MIDI_GAP_S);
note: The next song starts under the stopped one's queued quiet: its reset and first notes are answered by an all-notes-off meant for the song before.

name: MO1-the-stall-only-folded
old: for (const e of last.values()) this._control(e, now);
note: After a stalled tab the player's own state moves on and the device's does not: the song resumes on the instruments and volumes from before the gap.

name: MO1-the-bend-bytes-swapped
note: Pitch bend is LSB then MSB; swapped, a centred bend is a full bend down and every song plays out of tune.

name: MO1-a-velocity-sent-raw
note: The court's score adds accents past 127; a data byte with bit 7 set is a status byte to the device, and the stream after it is garbage.

name: MO1-a-status-nibble-wrong
note: Aftertouch sent as a controller change: the note's pressure becomes controller <note>, whatever that is.

name: MO1-a-reset-kept-as-state
note: A stall re-sends a channel-mode controller as if it were state: an all-notes-off or a reset-all-controllers lands after the state it was meant to precede.

name: MO1-the-slack-dropped
note: A release that rounds a femtosecond past a re-strike is not due, waits for the window's flush and lands after the new note-on: the note is cut.

name: MO1-the-release-at-its-rounded-time
note: Sent first, but timestamped a hair after the re-strike - and a device orders by timestamp.

name: MO1-the-pick-not-heard
note: The row writes the shelf and nothing moves until a reload.

name: MO1-the-pulled-device-kept
old: for (const o of a.outputs.values()) if (o.name === name && o.state !== 'disconnected') return o;
new: for (const o of a.outputs.values()) if (o.name === name) return o;
note: A device pulled out mid-song keeps the music: the game goes silent instead of handing it back to the synth.

name: MO1-the-overtaken-pick-adopted
note: ASYNC NEVER DROPS, the other half: a pick the player has already moved past restarts the song on that device before the latest lands.

name: MO1-the-device-row-unmapped
note: The row is drawn by its builder and placed nowhere: no player can reach the device pick.
